content: Gemini free-tier rate limits vary by model and reporting source; Flash-Lite class models have historically been cited around 15-30 RPM and 1000-1500 RPD, but official ai.google.dev rate-limits page (checked directly) no longer publishes a clean Free-tier table for current 3.x models -- must be confirmed live in AI Studio at implementation time, not assumed from training data or blog posts.
